findings.passage: My motivation for introducing this is simple: citizenship matters, and only citizens should have the vote.
findings.note: From his written sponsor testimony on SJR 6 (citizenship to vote in local elections) to the Senate Local Government and Elections Committee.

findings.passage: As it currently stands, you must be a US citizen to vote for federal and state level officeholders and issues.
findings.note: In the same testimony he says there is a possible gap at the local level that could let noncitizens vote in municipal or chartered-county elections, and that SJR 6 would close it.
